sources.source:
import json,subprocess,datetime,os
from pathlib import Path
q="SELECT json_build_object('current_user',current_user,'read_only',current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'),'statement_timeout',current_setting('statement_timeout'),'columns',(SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(c) ORDER BY c.column_name) FROM (SELECT column_name,data_type,character_maximum_length FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='users' AND column_name IN ('first_name','last_name','title','bio','tagline_mission','website','city','country','public_email')) c));"
r=subprocess.run(['psql','-w','-h','127.0.0.1','-p','15432','-U','vp_test_reader','-d','video_platform_db','-At','-c',q],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15,env={**os.environ,'PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT':'8'})
if r.returncode:raise SystemExit('Read-only profile schema check failed; no credential/error output retained')
x=json.loads(r.stdout);assert x['read_only']=='on';x['observed_at']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();Path('/private/tmp/vpqa-profile-schema-db-outcome.json').write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(x))
